# LoveHub

> AI-Powered Proposal & Love Letter Website Generator

LoveHub is a modern web application that enables users to create personalized, interactive proposal and anniversary websites for their partners.

## Core Features
- AI Proposal Generation: Server-side generation supporting multiple tones (Cute, Emotional, Filmy, Funny, Deep Romantic) in English and Hinglish.
- Interactive Proposal Pages: Responsive, celebration-ready web experiences with animated runaway "No" button, floating hearts, confetti bursts, and optional background music.
- Photo Memories: High-resolution photo upload slots with romantic captions.
- Custom Link Sharing: Instant unique proposal URLs shareable directly via WhatsApp, SMS, or QR code.
- User Accounts: Secure email/password and Google OAuth authentication with private dashboards.

## Important URLs
- Homepage: /
- Proposal Builder: /create
- User Dashboard: /dashboard
- Pricing & Plans: /checkout
- Login / Sign Up: /login, /signup

## Technical Stack
- Framework: Next.js (App Router, Server Components)
- Language: TypeScript
- Database: PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM)
- Authentication: better-auth
- Payments: Stripe
